entities.name: Paraska Plytka-Horytsvit
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Paraska Plytka-Horytsvit (1927–1998) was a Ukrainian Hutsul artist, writer, folk writer, philosopher, folk scientist, ethnographer and dialectologist. She was known as "Homer Hutsul."
